questions.question: Line r in the xy−plane has a slope of 2 and passes through the point (0, 12). Which equation defines line r?
questions.explanation: Slope-intercept form y = mx + b with m = 2 and b = 12 gives y = 2x + 12.

questions.question:
4x(x − 3)(x + 9) = 0
What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: The solutions are x = 0, x = 3, and x = −9. Only 0 is listed.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 12x + 18. What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?

The graph of y = f(x) is shown in the xy-plane.
What is the value of f(0)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the y-axis at (0, 5).

questions.question: Line r is shown in the xy-plane. Line t (not shown) is perpendicular to line r and passes through the point (5, 8). What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of line t?
questions.explanation: Line r passes through (0, −4) and (4, −1), so its slope is 3/4. Line t has slope −4/3: 8 = (−4/3)(5) + b gives b = 8 + 20/3 = 44/3.

questions.question: A certain open star cluster contains M-type stars and K-type stars. The estimated total mass of M-type and K-type stars in this open star cluster is 129,492 quettagrams. The graph shown models the possible combinations of the number of M-type stars, x, and K-type stars, y, that could be in this open star cluster if all the M-type stars have the same estimated mass and all the K-type stars have the same estimated mass. Based on the graph, which of the following is closest to the estimated mass, in quettagrams, of each M-type star in this cluster?
questions.explanation: The x-intercept (about 156) means 156 M-type stars account for all 129,492 quettagrams, so each has mass about 129,492/156 ≈ 830. (959 is the K-type star mass, from the y-intercept near 135.)

questions.question: Raheem bought 9 shirts that were each the same price. He used a coupon for $54 off the entire purchase. The cost for the entire purchase after using the coupon was $108. What was the original price, in dollars, for 1 shirt?
The product of a positive number x and the number that is 5 more than x is 104. What is the value of x?
Which expression is equivalent to 63x<sup>2</sup>?
Given x2 − 8116 = 0, how many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
questions.explanation: x² = 81/16 gives x = 9/4 or x = −9/4, so there are exactly two distinct real solutions.

questions.question:
x + 7 = 13
y = 5x2 + 5
At what point (x, y) do the graphs of the equations in the given system intersect?
questions.explanation: From x + 7 = 13, x = 6. Then y = 5(36) + 5 = 185, so the point is (6, 185).

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (3x<sup>3</sup> − 8x + 5) − (4x<sup>6</sup> + 9x − 2)?
questions.explanation: Distribute the negative: 3x³ − 8x + 5 − 4x⁶ − 9x + 2 = −4x⁶ + 3x³ − 17x + 7.

x2√x2 − c2 = c2√x2 − c2 + 39

In the given equation, c is a positive constant. Which of the following is one of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.topic: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables

questions.question:
y < x
y > −3x − 6
For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given system of inequalities?
questions.explanation: In choice C, each y is less than x and greater than −3x − 6 (for example, 3 < 7 and 3 > −27). Choices A and B fail one of the inequalities, and D fails y < x.

questions.question: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which data set has the greatest mean?
questions.explanation: The means are 500/18 ≈ 27.8 for A, and 25 for each of B, C and D, so A is greatest.

questions.question: The speed of a white-throated needletail, a type of bird, in flight was measured to be 49 miles per hour. What was the white-throated needletail's measured speed, in kilometers per hour? (Use 1 mile = 1.6 kilometers.)
questions.explanation: 49 × 1.6 = 78.4 kilometers per hour.

questions.question:
y > 2x − 72
y < −16x − 9
For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given system of inequalities?
questions.explanation: At x = 12, y must be between −48 and −11, and only −14 works in every row. A fails because −11 is not less than −11, C is below the line y = 2x − 72, and D is above the second line.

questions.question: A robotics club has $640 to spend. Each kit costs $37 plus 8% sales tax, and the club pays a single $25 shipping charge that is not taxed. What is the greatest number of kits the club can buy?

The function A(b) = 7b2 gives the area of a right triangle, in square centimeters (cm2), if the length of its base is b cm and the length of its height is 14 times the length of its base. Which of the following is the best interpretation of A(18) = 2,268?
options: If the length of the base of the triangle is 2,268 cm, then the length of the height of the triangle is 18 cm.
If the length of the base of the triangle is 18 cm, then the length of the height of the triangle is 2,268 cm.
If the length of the base of the triangle is 18 cm, then the area of the triangle is 2,268 cm<sup>2</sup>.
If the length of the base of the triangle is 2,268 cm, then the area of the triangle is 18 cm<sup>2</sup>.
questions.explanation: The input b = 18 is the base length and the output A(18) = 2,268 is the area, so a base of 18 cm gives an area of 2,268 cm^2.

questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angles A and B are acute, side AC has a length of 28.2, and tan B = 13. What is the length of side BC, rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: The right angle is at C, so tan B = AC/BC = 28.2/BC = 1/3, giving BC = 84.6.

questions.question: In triangle DEF, the measure of angle D is 47° and the measure of angle E is 97°. In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 47° and the measure of angle S is 97°. Which of the following additional pieces of information is needed to determine whether triangle DEF is similar to triangle RST?
options: The measure of angle F and the measure of angle T
questions.explanation: Two pairs of corresponding angles are congruent (47° and 97°), so the triangles are similar by AA.

questions.question: A park designer wants to find the length x, in feet, across a pond as represented in the figure. PR intersects ST at point Q, and angle PTQ is congruent to angle RSQ. The lengths represented by PQ, TQ, QS, and RS were determined to be 6,300 feet, 10,800 feet, 1,200 feet, and 1,800 feet, respectively. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Triangles PTQ and RSQ are similar. TQ/SQ = 10,800/1,200 = 9, so x = 9 × 1,800 = 16,200.

questions.question: If 3x = 8, what is the value of 21x?

Hassan put up wire fencing along each edge of a rectangular garden with a length of x feet and a width of y feet. Hassan put up a total length of 44 feet of wire fencing. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: The perimeter is 2x + 2y = 44.

What is the value of f(20)?

questions.explanation: The y-intercept occurs at x = 0, where f(0) = 14.

questions.question: The product of a positive number x and the number that is 15 less than x is equal to 286. What is the value of x?
A linear function g is defined by g(x) = ax + b, where a and b are constants. If g(−2) = −7 and g(1) = 5, what is the value of a?

The graph of line h is shown in the xy-plane. Line k (not shown) is defined by sx + 40y = t, where s and t are constants. If line k is graphed in this xy-plane, the result is a graph of two linear equations. This system of two linear equations has no solution. Which of the following is NOT a possible value of t?
questions.explanation: Line h is 2x + y = −8, or 80x + 40y = −320. No solution means line k is parallel to h but not the same line, so t cannot be −320. (This question’s last choice was cut off in the scan; Humo filled it in.)

questions.question: How many solutions does the equation 5x + 3 = 5x have?
questions.explanation: Subtracting 5x gives 3 = 0, which is never true, so there are no solutions.

questions.question:
x + 33 = y
(x + 33)2 = y
A solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is a possible value of x?
questions.explanation: Substituting gives y^2 = y, so y = 0 or 1. Then x = −33 or −32, and −32 is the choice offered.

questions.question: For the polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy−plane passes through the points (−4, 0), (1, 0), and (9, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the x-axis at x = 1, so f(1) = 0 and (x − 1) is a factor.

questions.question: The function k is defined by k(s) = √s + 110. If k(53p) = p, where p is a constant, what is the value of p?
questions.explanation: √(53p + 110) = p gives p^2 − 53p − 110 = 0, so (p − 55)(p + 2) = 0. Since a square root is not negative, p = 55.

questions.question: The graph of the quadratic function y = f(x) in the xy-plane intersects the x-axis when x = 39 and when x = p, where p is a constant. The maximum value of y = f(x) occurs at the point (14, m), where m is a constant. What is the value of p?
questions.explanation: The vertex lies midway between the x-intercepts: (39 + p)/2 = 14, so p = −11.

questions.question: A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the ground in terms of the time, in seconds, after the object was launched. According to the model, the object was launched from a height of 0 feet and reached its maximum height of 1,936 feet 11 seconds after it was launched. Based on the model, what was the height, in feet, of the object 5 seconds after it was launched?

At a convention center, there are a total of 375 visitors. Each visitor is located in either room A, room B, or room C. If one of these visitors is selected at random, the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room A is 0.64, and the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room B is 0.32. How many visitors are located in room C?
questions.explanation: The probability for room C is 1 − 0.64 − 0.32 = 0.04, and 0.04 × 375 = 15.

questions.question: In each of the following data sets of 5 values, p is a constant. Which of these data sets has the largest standard deviation?
questions.explanation: All sets have mean p; set D has the values farthest from the mean (±5, ±4), so it has the largest spread.

questions.question: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 304 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a rate of 0.6 pound per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation did the black bear weigh 250 pounds?
questions.explanation: The bear lost 304 − 250 = 54 pounds, which takes 54 ÷ 0.6 = 90 days.

questions.question: A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 1,250 people attended the first webinar. 46% of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and 32% of the people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people attended all three webinars?
questions.explanation: 1,250 × 0.46 = 575 attended the first two, and 575 × 0.32 = 184 attended all three.

questions.question: A hemisphere is half of a sphere. If a hemisphere has a radius of 69 inches, which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of this hemisphere?

Quadrilateral MNOP is similar to quadrilateral QRST such that M, N, O, and P correspond to Q, R, S, and T, respectively. The length of each side of quadrilateral MNOP is 2 times the length of its corresponding side in quadrilateral QRST. The measure of angle P is 50° and ST = 8. Which of the following must be true?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles of similar figures are equal, and angle T corresponds to angle P, so angle T is 50°. (OP = 2 × 8 = 16, so A and D are false.)

questions.question: In a right triangle, the measure of one of the acute angles is 14°. What is the measure of the other acute angle, in degrees? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
questions.explanation: The acute angles of a right triangle sum to 90°, so the other is 90 − 14 = 76°.

The density of a certain type of marble stone is 2.2000 grams per cubic centimeter. If a sample of this type of stone is in the shape of a sphere with a diameter of 33.000 centimeters, what is the mass of this sample, in grams, to the nearest whole number? (Use 3.14159 for π.)
questions.explanation: The radius is 16.5 cm, so the volume is (4/3)(3.14159)(16.5)^3 ≈ 18,816.1 cm³. Multiplying by the density 2.2 gives about 41,396 grams.
